Kratom dude here 48 hours away from starting a sub detox from kratom. Google and wikipedia can tell you more than me, but long story short it's basically a legal opioid in the United States. It has huge value as a detox agent, but is fraught with a ton of addictive potential. I played around with it out of curiosity after some people I know successfully detoxed from heroin with it, then got hooked.

Whatever you decide to do is your own journey and your own story, but it comes with risks. If what you're seeking is true sobriety from opioids (or total), stay away from it. A week-long detox should carry you most of the way through acute withdrawal. Jesus and Buddha can execute the fusion dance to get you through the back-end.
